query: Review a PR that adds src/config/runtime.ts with adminDebugToken = "demo-admin-token-please-rotate".
expected: Flag a high severity hardcoded secret and recommend env/managed secret usage without repeating the token value.

query: Review a PR that changes canReleaseOrder so every support user can release every order regardless of risk.
expected: Flag uncontrolled permission widening as high severity and suggest restoring risk/status checks.

query: Review a PR that lets support users view billing data previously restricted to admin and finance.
expected: Flag authorization regression and ask for explicit product approval or scoped permission.

query: Review a React PR that renders order tags with dangerouslySetInnerHTML through renderSupportNoteHtml.
expected: Flag XSS risk and suggest escaping/rendering as text or sanitizing with a vetted sanitizer.

query: Review a DataTable change that replaces stable row keys with Math.random().
expected: Flag unstable keys as maintainability/performance issue causing remounts and state loss.

query: Review a hook change that removes cancellation cleanup from async resource loading.
expected: Flag possible state update after unmount/race condition and restore cleanup.

query: Review useDebouncedValue where delayMs is removed from the effect dependency list.
expected: Flag stale delay behavior and explain dependency correctness.

query: Review a billing service that mutates imported invoice fixtures to mark an invoice paid.
expected: Flag mutation of shared module data and suggest immutable state/API-backed update.

query: Review reserveInventoryForOrder that subtracts quantity without bounds checking.
expected: Flag possible negative inventory and missing validation.

query: Review AnalyticsDashboard creating and sorting 20,000 entries during render.
expected: Flag expensive render work and suggest memoization or precomputed service data.

query: Review Toolbar where a labelled input is replaced by an unlabeled input with only placeholder text.
expected: Flag accessibility regression and restore a label or aria-label.

query: Review AccessPanel and AdminDebugPanel displaying runtimeConfig.adminDebugToken in the UI.
expected: Flag secret/debug data exposure and recommend removing from UI/logs.

query: Review main.tsx logging localStorage session at boot.
expected: Flag potential PII/session leakage in logs and remove or redact.

query: Review a button that loops over overdue orders and calls window.open for each one.
expected: Flag poor UX/security risk and suggest single navigable view or explicit user action.

query: Review tests changed to expect support release on high-risk orders after permission widening.
expected: Flag test weakening that codifies unsafe behavior instead of catching it.

query: Review customer search that filters by JSON.stringify(customer) on every render.
expected: Flag inefficient and imprecise search and suggest targeted fields with memoization.

query: Review unsafeParseMoney using replace for currency parsing.
expected: Flag locale/currency parsing fragility if used and suggest typed numeric values or robust parser.

query: Review sortOrdersForExport calling input.sort directly.
expected: Flag mutation of caller-owned array and suggest copying before sorting.

query: Review sendAuditBeacon that ignores success/failure and sends raw audit JSON.
expected: Suggest handling return value or documenting fire-and-forget and validating payload privacy.

query: Review a PR adding new realistic orders/customers/inventory fixtures with typed domain objects.
expected: Do not over-report; acknowledge no issue if data matches existing types and conventions.
